prompt.en: A battery current is 640 mA. What is the same current in amperes?

explanation.en: Milliamperes are thousandths of an ampere, so divide 640 by 1 000.

prompt.en: Which statement best describes an insulator in a simple circuit?

text.en: It can still conduct a little under some conditions, but it strongly resists normal current flow.
It is chosen when a circuit needs the lowest possible resistance path.
It is a material whose conductivity is between metal conductors and insulators.
It is used to carry the return current in a coax shield.

explanation.en: Insulators separate conductors and help keep current on the intended path.

prompt.en: Why is polarity important when connecting a DC radio accessory?

text.en: Some DC circuits can be damaged when the positive and negative leads are swapped.
It changes a conductor into a semiconductor material.
It makes current flow in an open circuit with no return path.
It sets the frequency shown on the receiver dial.

explanation.en: DC equipment often expects positive and negative leads to be connected correctly.
